The '''Imberlin sector''' was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Imberlin system/Legends|Imberlin]], [[Silorna system/Legends|Silorna]], and [[Zaraksander system/Legends|Zaraksander systems]], and the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] passed through the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. At various points, the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|military]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] and forces of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]], [[Tof/Legends|Tof]], and [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] all traveled along the section of the Gamor Run running through the Imberlin sector.

==Description==
The Imberlin [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion<ref name="Slice" /> of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Imberlin sector bordered the [[Hilo sector/Legends|Hilo]] and [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sectors]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[Dimean sector/Legends|Dimean sector]] [[spinward]], and the [[Charra sector/Legends|Charra sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]], the Imberlin sector also formed a three-way border with the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Fei Hu sector/Legends|Fei Hu]] and [[Sloo sector/Legends|Sloo sectors]].<ref name="Expansion" /> The Imberlin sector contained the [[Imberlin system/Legends|Imberlin]], [[Silorna system/Legends|Silorna]], and [[Zaraksander system/Legends|Zaraksander systems]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] traveled through the sector,<ref name="Gamor" /> connecting the [[Charra system/Legends|Charra system]] in the Charra sector to the Fei Hu sector's [[Aikhibba system/Legends|Aikhibba system]].<ref name="Expansion" />

==History==
[[File:VongGamorRun-TEA.png|thumb|right|250px|The forces of the Yuuzhan Vong traveled through the Imberlin sector during the species' invasion of the galaxy.]]
By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="32 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' depicts the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] moving its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|armed forces]] along the [[Gamor Run/Legends|Gamor Run]] during the build-up to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Blockade of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> while preparing for its upcoming [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] moved its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|armed forces]] along<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the section of the Gamor Run passing through the Imberlin sector<ref name="Gamor" /> on their way to the Trade Federation distribution center on the Mid Rim<ref name="TEA" /> world<ref name="TwinStars">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref> of [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]]. While moving spinward as part of secondary movements of their [[Nagai–Tof War|separate invasions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the forces of the [[Firefist|extragalactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tof]] [[Species/Legends|species]] traveled along the same section<ref name="TEA" /> of the Gamor Run.<ref name="Gamor" /> Between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], after [[Battle of the Daalang system|conquering]] the [[Daalang system/Legends|Daalang system]] as part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] also advanced along the portion<ref name="TEA" /> of the Gamor Run running through the Imberlin sector<ref name="Gamor" /> before attacking the [[Osarian system|Osarian]] and [[Tynnani system]]s.<ref name="TEA" />

==Locations==
The Silorna [[Star system/Legends|system]] was the origin point of the type of [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] known as the [[Silorna Force Crystal]].<ref name="Shadows">{{LivingForce|Shadows in Green}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Silorna Force Crystal]]|system=[[Silorna system/Legends|Silorna system]]|legends=1}}</ref> At some point by [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> an independent [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] ran afoul of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities in the Imberlin system. The [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Findsman/Legends|findsman]] [[Lu'daal-ud]] subsequently captured the trader.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

The Zaraksander system contained the terrestrial astronomical object of the [[Zaraksander|same name]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the company [[Eloinie Petro-Munitions]] was based on Zaraksander. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Valken Gresh]] visited the celestial body's [[Fioer desert]] on two separate occasions and later recorded the experience in the work ''[[Great Hunts I've Lived To Tell About]]''.<ref name="GG10">{{WEGCite|story=You Never Can Tell|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imberlin sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the Imberlin sector was illustrated on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-expansion-region Essential Atlas Extra: Expansion Region]," which placed it in grid squares P-13 and P-14.<ref name="Expansion" />
